author: The Current
description:
Bad Bad Hats' Kerry Alexander talks about the all-homegrown acts playing at Taste of Minnesota 2026
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

The 2026 edition of Taste of Minnesota happens Friday and Saturday, July 3 and 4, and both nights feature an all-Minnesota music lineup. Friday's lineup includes Bad Bad Hats, and Kerry Alexander from Bad Bad Hats joins The Current's Jill Riley to talk about the music at Taste of Minnesota and to give a preview of what to expect from Bad Bad Hats' set. 

Credits
Guest – Kerry Alexander of @badbadhats
